summary: Batch #6 backend + frontend verification (Time Capsules, Weekly Highlights, Memory Map/Places). BACKEND: 11/11 tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_batch6_api.py. Time Capsules — GET /api/capsules returns 2 seeded caps: locked one hides message/media (only capsule_id, unlock_date, is_locked=true, days_until, created_at, author) while unlocked one exposes message/media; POST /api/capsules with future date creates a sealed capsule (locked view returned, days_until≈45); POST with past date or today → 400; POST with empty/whitespace message → 400; GET /api/capsules/{id} of a sealed cap also hides message; DELETE by non-author (capsuletester=Raj deleting Priya's cap) → 403; DELETE by author → 200 and follow-up GET → 404. Highlights — GET /api/highlights/week returns {period{from,to}, counts{posts,memories,wishes,loves}, top_poster, posts[], memories[]} with all int counters and memory items carrying id/title/date. Places — GET /api/timeline/places returns 7 groups sorted by count desc, each with {location,count,cover}; GET /api/timeline?location=<X> filters correctly and is case-insensitive (exact / lower / upper all return same subset); unknown location returns []. FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844, capsuletester@fam.com/secret123): Time Capsules — More→more-capsule opens list with 2 seeded cards (Priya's Sealed 'Opens in 120 days · 14 Dec 2026' with message hidden, Raj's Unlocked with visible message); fab-add-capsule opens create screen; capsule-message-input + capsule-preset-30 + save-capsule-btn creates a new sealed capsule with 'Opens in 30 days · 15 Sep 2026' — message NOT leaked on list; tapping the new sealed capsule shows detail with 'Sealed until', '🔒', countdown, and NO message text; tapping the unlocked capsule shows 'Unlocked', 💌 hero, and full message ('A note from last month: I'm so proud of every single one of you...'). Weekly Highlights — more-highlights opens screen with 'This Week's Highlights', a period label, 4 stat cards (Posts shared / Memories added / Birthday wishes / Love sent), a 'MOST ACTIVE THIS WEEK' top-poster card, and 6 hl-memory-<id> rows; tapping hl-memory-<id> opens the memory detail (memory-love visible). Places — more-places opens 2-column grid with 7 tiles (Delhi, Delhi Public School, Home, Community Ground, Dubai, Gurgaon, Kerala); tapping place-Delhi navigates to timeline filtered by that location — header reads 'Delhi ❤️ / 2 memories preserved' and only 2 memory-<tid> cards render. REGRESSION — More→more-timeline unfiltered shows all 8 seeded memories; memory-love toggles '0 loves' → '1 love' correctly; adding a note via memory-comment-input + memory-comment-send appends memory-comment-<id> and increments to '1 note'. All batch #6 testIDs functional. NOTE: Home 'sunday-highlights' card only renders on Sundays — not tested per review-note (today is Sat).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2224 lines — growth from 2038 with capsules/highlights/places. Router split overdue.
CapsuleIn.message has no length cap; consider max_length via pydantic Field to prevent huge payloads.

_capsule_view compares ISO strings (`cap['unlock_date'] > date.today().isoformat()`) — works because YYYY-MM-DD sorts lexicographically, but a comment or explicit date.fromisoformat compare would be more robust.
GET /api/capsules loads every capsule's author with a per-doc query (N+1); fine for the demo (~2 caps) but should batch when families accumulate hundreds.

/highlights/week /_mini() only picks the first media element for post cover; if post.media is [] but post has no key 'media', `(p.get('media') or [{}])[0].get('url')` returns None safely — OK, but the expression is fragile; consider a helper.
GET /timeline/places has no auth-required test for empty family (only exercised via seeded demo). Not a defect but coverage gap.
